sources.title: How CRISPR Editing Works
sources.summary: Introduces the molecular mechanism of CRISPR gene editing.
sources.thesis: CRISPR is a programmable DNA editing tool guided by RNA.
sources.centralQuestion: CRISPR is a programmable DNA editing tool guided by RNA.

claims.statement: CRISPR uses a guide RNA molecule to direct an enzyme to a specific DNA sequence for precise edits.
claims.evidenceSummary: CRISPR uses a guide RNA molecule to direct an enzyme to a specific DNA sequence for precise edits. Researchers design the guide sequence to match a target gene, allowing the Cas enzyme to cut or modify only that location.

conclusions: CRISPR is a programmable DNA editing tool guided by RNA.
